decisions.reason: As a small accessory with only a short independent web presence and no later visibility, it likely fell below aspiration levels and its resources are better redirected to stronger core products or development projects.

Although initially prominent on the home page, its disappearance after 2019 suggests results did not continue to meet aspiration levels, so a medium-sized German trailer maker would reallocate capacity to better-performing lines.

The car transporter trailer appears to have remained a niche offer with limited persistence, indicating performance uncertainty and a behavioral-theory case for problemistic search and resource redeployment.
Despite early home-page prominence, the lack of later market visibility points to performance not sustaining the firm’s aspiration level, making withdrawal the likely bounded-rational response.
The high trailer cover series seems not to have secured lasting salience after launch, so management would likely drop it once outcomes no longer justified using organisational slack.
A second box car trailer series with only brief prominence likely created overlap without sufficient sustained results, so management would discontinue it and focus on the established range.
